what_this_is: six questions asked over HTTP against the deployed service and its Neon PostgreSQL pgvector index, to show the deployed system behaves as the in-process artifacts describe
what_this_is_not: an evaluation. It scores nothing and changes no published metric. The multilingual smoke below is three queries, not the per-language measurement in multilingual.json, and none of it bears on the twelve predeclared kill conditions -- in particular a working pgvector deployment does not make kill condition K pass, because K asks for an index scan in the query plan and the planner prefers a sequential scan over the small filtered candidate set

observed.reason: 5 passages in force on 2023-01-01 agree on one variant and cover 1.00 of the question's terms
observed.text:

Tighten the baseplate mounting foot bolts of the AX7-160 to 52 Nm, in diagonally opposite pairs, with the machine cold and the coupling halves disconnected.

Tighten the pump-to-gearbox mounting flange bolts on the AX7-160 to 40 Nm, working outward from the dowel in a star pattern over three passes.

Drive coupling bolt torque — AX7-160

citations.quote:
Baseplate mounting foot bolt torque — AX7-160
Tighten the baseplate mounting foot bolts of the AX7-160 to 52 Nm, in diagonally opposite pairs, with the machine cold and the coupling halves disconnected.

Mounting flange bolt torque — AX7-160
Tighten the pump-to-gearbox mounting flange bolts on the AX7-160 to 40 Nm, working outward from the dowel in a star pattern over three passes.

Drive coupling bolt torque — AX7-160
Tighten the drive coupling bolts on the AX7-160 to 48 Nm in a diagonal sequence.
Hydraulic reservoir capacity — AX7-160
Gearbox oil grade — AX7-160

approved_evidence:
1.12. Baseplate mounting foot bolt torque — AX7-160
Tighten the baseplate mounting foot bolts of the AX7-160 to 52 Nm, in diagonally opposite pairs, with the machine cold and the coupling halves disconnected. Every foot must bed fully on shim pack DF-3277-S before torque is applied; pulling a soft foot down with the bolt distorts the housing and drags the shaft out of alignment. Re-check each foot

1.11. Mounting flange bolt torque — AX7-160
Tighten the pump-to-gearbox mounting flange bolts on the AX7-160 to 40 Nm, working outward from the dowel in a star pattern over three passes. Fit gasket GY-5680-F dry; a lubricated or re-used gasket bleeds off preload and the joint relaxes below the specified figure within a shift. Do not torque the flange while the casing is above 65 °C — the bolts los

1.1. Drive coupling bolt torque — AX7-160
Tighten the drive coupling bolts on the AX7-160 to 48 Nm in a diagonal sequence. Use fastener set LU-2887-H only; a fastener of a lower grade will not hold this figure. Re-check the torque after the first 400 operating hours.
Applies to AX7-160, all serial numbers.

1.3. Hydraulic reservoir capacity — AX7-160
The hydraulic reservoir of the AX7-160 holds 55 L to the upper sight-glass mark. Fill through filler cap YX-8484-IJ; filling through the return port bypasses the screen. Do not exceed the mark — expansion at 82 °C vents oil through the breather.
Applies to AX7-160, all serial numbers.

1.9. Gearbox oil grade — AX7-160
The gearbox of the AX7-160 takes ISO VG 32 oil. Drain plug magnet GS-1262-JY9 is inspected at the same interval. Mixing grades raises the pour point and the unit will not start below minus 25 °C.
Applies to AX7-160, all serial numbers.

parameters.q: What is the maximum permissible case drain pressure for the AX7-165?

observed.reason: 5 passages in force on 2021-06-17 agree on one variant and cover 0.83 of the question's terms
observed.text:
Case drain pressure limit — AX7-165

A clogged element raises case pressure and will fail the pump within 250 hours.
Applies to AX7-165, all serial numbers.

Pilot circuit pressure setting — AX7-165

The cooling circuit of the AX7-165 holds 120 L between the minimum and maximum marks of the expansion tank.

The gearbox of the AX7-165 takes ISO VG 138 oil. Drain plug magnet XY-4233-O is inspected at the same interval.

citations.quote: Case drain pressure limit — AX7-165

A clogged element raises case pressure and will fail the pump within 250 hours.
Applies to AX7-165, all serial numbers.
Pilot circuit pressure setting — AX7-165
The cooling circuit of the AX7-165 holds 120 L between the minimum and maximum marks of the expansion tank.
The gearbox of the AX7-165 takes ISO VG 138 oil. Drain plug magnet XY-4233-O is inspected at the same interval.

approved_evidence:
3.23. Case drain pressure limit — AX7-165
Case drain pressure on the AX7-165 must not exceed 9 bar, measured at the drain port with the oil at working temperature. Fit gauge adapter NC-2641-0EK in the drain line; a reading taken downstream of the cooler is low by the cooler's own loss at 100 l/min. Pressure above this figure lifts the shaft seal and the pump loses charge within one shift.
Applies

3.2. Return-line filter element — AX7-165
The return-line filter element for the AX7-165 is QX-6058-86. Replace it together with sealing ring MX-3033-06 at every service interval; the ring is not reusable. A clogged element raises case pressure and will fail the pump within 250 hours.
Applies to AX7-165, all serial numbers.

3.22. Pilot circuit pressure setting — AX7-165
Set the pilot circuit of the AX7-165 to 310 bar with the main circuit unloaded and the oil at working temperature. Take the reading at gauge port CR-5434-CGA rather than at the pump outlet; the outlet reading includes line loss at 25 l/min. A pilot pressure set below this figure will not shift the main spool under load.
Applies to AX7-165, all serial

3.24. Cooling circuit fill volume — AX7-165
The cooling circuit of the AX7-165 holds 120 L between the minimum and maximum marks of the expansion tank. Fill through cap ZE-5808-ZNQ with the circuit cold; filling hot traps air in the top of the cooler core. Do not exceed the upper mark — expansion at 82 °C discharges coolant through the relief cap.
Applies to AX7-165, all serial numbers.

3.9. Gearbox oil grade — AX7-165
The gearbox of the AX7-165 takes ISO VG 138 oil. Drain plug magnet XY-4233-O is inspected at the same interval. Mixing grades raises the pour point and the unit will not start below minus 15 °C.
Applies to AX7-165, all serial numbers.
